verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              त्रिभागमात्रशेषायां रात्र्यां युद्धमवर्तत।  कुरूणां पाण्डवानां च संमृष्टानां विशांपते॥१॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said When three fourths of the night had passed away, O ruler of men, once more the battle, between the delighted Kurus and Pandavas, commenced.

verses.sanskrit: अथ चन्द्रप्रभां मुष्णन्नादित्यस्य पुरःसरः।  अरुणोऽभ्युदयांचक्रे ताम्रीकुर्वन्निवाम्बरम्॥२॥
verses.english: Soon after Arjuna (the sun's charioteer) robbing the effulgence of the moon, appeared on the sky, spreading a coppery hue over it.
verses.bhavadeepa: त्रिभागमात्रशेषायां मुहूर्तत्रयावशिष्टायाम् । तत्र सूर्योदयोत्तरं त्रयोदश्यां द्रोणस्य नाशः । त्रयोदश्यां शुक्लायां युद्धारंभस्य ‘हेमन्ते प्रथमे मासे शुक्लपक्षे त्रयोदशीम् । प्रवृत्तं भारतं युद्धम्’ - इति भारतसावित्र्यामुक्तस्य चोपपत्तिः सिद्ध्यति ॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: प्राच्यां दिशि सहस्रांशोररुणेनारुणीकृतम्।  तापनीयं यथा चक्रं भ्राजते रविमण्डलम्॥३॥
ततो रथाश्वांश्च मनुष्ययानान्युत्सृज्य सर्वे कुरुपाण्डुयोधाः।  दिवाकरस्याभिमुखं जपन्तः सन्ध्यागताः प्राञ्जलयो बभूवुः॥४॥
ततो द्वैधीकृते सैन्ये द्रोणः सोमकपाण्डवान्। अभ्यद्रवत्सपञ्चालान्दुर्योधनपुरोगमः॥५॥
verses.english: The host of the Kauravas having been divided into two parts, Diona, having Duryodhana in front of him, advanced (supported by one of this divisions) against the Somakas, the Panchalas and the Pandavas.

verses.sanskrit: द्वैधीकृतान्कुरून् दृष्ट्वा माधवोऽर्जुनमब्रवीत्।  सपत्नान्सव्यतः कृत्वा अपसव्यमिमं कुरु॥६॥
verses.english: Then beholding the Kuru army divided in twain, the scion of Madhu's race, Krishna addressing Arjuna said-"Keeping the other division of the enemy to your left, place Drona's division to your right.”

verses.sanskrit: स माधवमनुज्ञाय कुरुष्वेति धनञ्जयः।  द्रोणकर्णौ महेष्वासौ सव्यतः पर्यवर्तत॥७॥
अभिप्रायं तु कृष्णस्य ज्ञात्वा परपुरञ्जयः।  आजिशीर्षगतं पार्थं भीमसेनोऽभ्युवाच ह॥८॥

भीमसेन उवाच।
              अर्जुनार्जुन बीभत्सो शृणुष्वैतद्वचो मम।  यदर्थं क्षत्रिया सूते तस्य कालोऽयमागत॥९॥
verses.english: Bhimasena said Ho, Arjuna, Arjuna, O Vibhatsu, hear these words of mine! The hour, for the realisation of that object for which Kshatriya ladies bring forth their sons, has now arrived.

verses.sanskrit: अस्मिंश्चेदागते काले श्रेयो न प्रतिपत्स्यसे।  असंभावितरूपस्त्वं सुनृशंसं करिष्यसि॥१०॥
सत्य-श्री-धर्म-यशसां वीर्येणानृण्यमाप्नुहि।  भिन्ध्यनीकं युधां श्रेष्ठ अपसव्यमिमान्कुरु॥११॥
verses.english: With the assistance of mighty do you, today, pay off your debt to Prosperity and Fame! ( foremost of warriors, penetrate into this army and keep this to your right.

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              स सव्यसाची भीमेन चोदितः केशवेन च।  कर्णद्रोणावतिक्रम्य समन्तात्पर्यवारयत्॥१२॥
तमाजिशीर्षमायान्तं दहन्तं क्षत्रियर्षभान्।  पराक्रान्तं पराक्रम्य ततः क्षत्रियपुङ्गवाः॥१३॥
नाशक्नुवन्वारयितुं वर्धमानमिवानलम्।  अथ दुर्योधनः कर्णः शकुनिश्चापि सौबलः॥१४॥
verses.english: Could not check him even as men cannot check the raging conflagration. Thereupon Duryodhana, Karna and Subala's son Sakuni.

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यवर्षञ्छरव्रातैः कुन्तीपुत्रं धनञ्जयम्।  तेषामस्त्राणि सर्वेषामुत्तमास्त्रविदां वरः॥१५॥
verses.english: Began to shower thousands of arrows on Kunti's son Arjuna. That foremost of all, versed in excellent weapons, baffling all the weapons hurled by his opponents, poured on them, O foremost of king's a veritable shower of arrows. Of controlled senses and endued with great lightness of hand, he repulsed the weapons shot at him by those of his own.

verses.sanskrit: कदर्थी कृत्य राजेन्द्र शरवर्षैरवाकिरत्।  अस्त्रैरस्त्राणि संवार्य लघुहस्तो जितेन्द्रियः॥१६॥
सर्वानविध्यन्निशितैर्दशभिर्दशभिः शरैः।  उद्धूता रजसो वृष्टिः शरवृष्टिस्तथैव च॥१७॥
verses.english: Then he pierced each of his foes with ten sharp shafts. The welkin was shrouded in a cloud of dust and showers of arrows fell thick.

verses.sanskrit: तमश्च घोरं शब्दश्च तदा समभवन्महान्।  न द्यौर्न भूमिर्न दिशः प्राज्ञायन्त तथागते॥१८॥
verses.english: Impenetrable darkness set in and dreadful tumult prevailed on the field of battle. When such was the condition of things, neither the sky nor the earth, nor the points of the compass, were recognised.

verses.sanskrit: सैन्येन रजसा मूढं सर्वमन्धमिवाभवत्।  नैव ते न वयं राजन्प्राज्ञासिष्म परस्परम्॥१९॥
verses.english: one a Confounded with the dust thc troops became blind. Neither the foe, O monarch, nor we could distinguish one another.

verses.sanskrit: उद्देशेन हि तेन स्म समयुध्यन्त पार्थिवाः।  विरथा रथिनो राजन्समासाद्य परस्परम्॥२०॥
verses.english: For this reason, the royal combatants fought on guided by conjecture and the challenges they uttered. Destitute of chariots, the carwarriors, O monarch, encountering another, lost all order and became confounded mass. Their horses slain the charioteer killed, many, becoming incapacitated, saved their lives and looked highly frightened. Staughtered steeds, with their riders slain, were seen to lie over elephants as if prostrate on mountain tops. Then Drona, inoving towards the northern quarter of the field.

verses.sanskrit: केशेषु समसज्जन्त कवचेषु भुजेषु च।  हताश्वा हतसुताश्च निश्चेष्टा रथिनो हताः॥२१॥
जीवन्त इव तत्र स्म व्यदृश्यन्त भयार्दिताः।  हतान् गजान्समाश्लिष्य पर्वतानिव वाजिनः॥२२॥
गतसत्त्वा व्यदृश्यन्त तथैव सह सादिभिः।  ततस्त्वभ्यवसृत्यैव संग्रामादुत्तरां दिशम्॥२३॥
आतिष्ठ बाहवे द्रोणो विधूमोऽग्निरिव ज्वलन्।  तमाजिशीर्षादेकान्तमपक्रान्तं निशम्य तु॥२४॥
verses.english: Stood like fire free from smoke. Then beholding him move away from the field (towards the North).

verses.sanskrit: समकम्पन्त सैन्यानि पाण्डवानां विशांपते।  भ्राजमानं श्रिया युक्तं ज्वलन्तमिव तेजसा॥२५॥
verses.english: O ruler of men, the Pandava troops began to tremble. Beholding Drona exceedingly handsome and attended with prosperity and burning in his own effulgence, the soldiers of the enemy were affrighted, depressed and routed, O Bharata.-Challenging the hostile host as he stood, like an infuriate elephant in rut.

verses.sanskrit: द्रोणं दृष्ट्वा परे त्रेसुश्चेरुर्मम्लुश्च भारत।  आह्वयन्तं परानीकं प्रभिन्नमिव वारणम्॥२६॥
नैनमाशंसिरे जेतुं दानवा वासवं यथा।  केचिदासन्निरुत्साहाः केचित्क्रुद्धा मनस्विनः॥२७॥
verses.english: None ventured to conquer him even as the Danavas could not conquer Vasava. Some were depressed at heart and some intelligent warriors became inspired with rage.

verses.sanskrit: विस्मिताश्चाभवन्केचित् केचिदासन्नमर्षिताः।  हस्तैर्हस्ताग्रमपरे प्रत्यपिंषन्नराधिपाः॥२८॥
verses.english: Some were filled with wonder and some could not beer him. Some rubbed their hands.

verses.sanskrit: अपरे दशनैरोष्ठान् दशनक्रोधमूच्छिताः।  व्याक्षिपन्नायुधान्यन्ये ममृदुश्चापरे भुजान्॥२९॥
verses.english: Others, overwhelmed with rage, began to bite their lips, with their teeth. Others began to hurl missiles at him and others to rule their arins.

verses.sanskrit: अन्ये चान्वपतन्द्रोणं त्यक्तात्मानो महौजसः।  पञ्चालास्तु विशेषेण द्रोणसायकपीडिताः॥३०॥
verses.english: Other warriors, of controlled passions and great might, fell upon Drona. Specially the Panchalas, though afflicted with the shafts of Drona.

verses.sanskrit: समसजन्त राजेन्द्र समरे भृशवेदनाः।  ततो विराटद्रुपदौ द्रोणं प्रति ययू रणे॥३१॥
verses.english: And suffering extreme pain, O king, fought on with Drona. Thereafter Virata and Drupada, both rushed against Drona in battle.

verses.sanskrit: तथा चरन्तं संग्रामे भृशं समरदुर्जयम्।  द्रुपदस्य ततः पौत्रास्त्रय एव विशांपते॥३२॥
verses.english: Who, invincible as he was in battle, was roving freely on the field. Then O ruler of men, the grandsons of Drupada, in three number.

verses.sanskrit: चेदयश्च महेष्वासा द्रोणमेवाभ्ययुर्युधि। तेषां द्रुपद‌पौत्राणां त्रयाणां निशितैः शरैः॥३३॥
verses.english: And the Chedis, all fierce bowmen, assailed Drona in battle. Of those three grandsons of Drupada, with sharp arrows.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिभिर्दोणोऽहरत्प्राणांस्ते हता न्यपतन्भुवि।  ततो द्रोणोऽजयद्युद्धे चेदिकैकेयसृञ्जयान्॥३४॥
verses.english: Three in number Drona robbed the vital breaths, whereupon they fell down dead on the ground. Thereafter Drona vanquished in battle, the Chedis the Kaikayas and the Srinjayas.

verses.sanskrit: मत्स्यांश्चैवाजयत्कृत्स्नान् भारद्वाजो महारथान्।  ततस्तु द्रुपदः क्रोधाच्छरवर्षमवासृजत्॥३५॥
verses.english: That mighty car-warrior the son of Bharadvaja then also conquered the Matsyas. Thereafter Drupada, worked up with rage, poured a shower of arrows.

verses.sanskrit: द्रोणं प्रति महाराज विराटश्चैव संयुगे।  तं निहत्येषुवर्षं तु द्रोणः क्षत्रियमर्दनः॥३६॥
verses.english: On Drona, O mighty monarch. Virata also did so in that battle. Then that crusher of foes, viz., Drona, destroying that shower of arrows.

verses.sanskrit: तौ शरैश्छादयामास विराटद्रुपदावुभौ।  द्रोणेन च्छाद्यमानौ तु क्रुद्धौ संग्राममूर्धनि॥३७॥
verses.english: Covered the two, Drupada and Virata with his own arrows. Thus covered by Drona and inflamed with wrath at the head of battle.

verses.sanskrit: द्रोणं शरैर्विव्यधतुः परमं क्रोधमास्थितौ।  ततो द्रोणो महाराज क्रोधामर्षसमन्वितः॥३८॥
verses.english: Those two heroes began to afflict Drona wrathfully in that battle. O mighty monarch, therefore, Drona filled with rage and fury.

verses.sanskrit: भल्लाभ्यां भृशतीक्ष्णाभ्यां चिच्छेद धनुषी तयोः।  ततो विराटः कुपितः समरे तोमरान्दश॥३९॥
verses.english: Cut off the bows cf them both with a couple of broad headed shafts of great sharpness. Thereupon, filled with rage, Virata hurled ten tomaras.

verses.sanskrit: दश चिक्षेप च शरान्द्रोणस्य वधकांक्षया। शक्तिं च द्रुपदो घोरामायसीं स्वर्णभूषिताम्॥४०॥
verses.english: As also ten shafts at Drona, with a view to encompass his slaughter. Drupada also, equally enraged, hurled at the car of Drona, a dreadful dart made wholly of iron and decked with gold and effulgent like the body of a excellent snake. Then cutting off with a well-sharpened bhalla those tomaras.

verses.sanskrit: चिक्षेप भुजगेन्द्राभां क्रुद्धो द्रोणरथं प्रति।  ततो भल्लैः सुनिशितैश्छित्त्वा तांस्तोमरान्दश॥४१॥
शक्तिं कनकवैदूर्यां द्रोणाश्चिच्छेद सायकैः।  ततो द्रोणः सुपीताभ्यां भल्लाभ्यामरिमर्दनः॥४२॥
verses.english: Drona cut-off the dart adorned with gold and lapises shot at him with his own arrows. Then that crusher of foes., viz., Drona with a couple of well-tempered bhalla.

verses.sanskrit: द्रुपदं च विराटं च प्रेषयामास मृत्यवे।  हते विराटे द्रुपदे केकयेषु तथैव च॥४३॥
verses.english: Dispatched both Drupada and Virata to the region of Death. Upon the slaughter of Virata and Drupada and the Kaikayas also.

verses.sanskrit: तथैव चेदिमत्स्येषु पञ्चालेषु तथैव च।  हतेषु त्रिषु वीरेषु द्रुपदस्य च नप्तृषु॥४४॥
verses.english: As also the Chedis and the Panchalas and the Matsyas and upon the slaughter of the three heroic grandsons of Drupada.

verses.sanskrit: द्रोणस्य कर्म तद्दृष्ट्वा कोपदुःखसमन्वितः।  शशाप रथिनां मध्ये धृष्टद्युम्नो महामनाः॥४५॥
verses.english: And beholding these cruel deeds accomplished by Drona, the high-souled Dhristadyumna, filled with rage and grief,

verses.sanskrit: इष्टापूर्तात्तथा क्षात्राद्ब्राह्मण्याच्च स नश्यतु।  द्रोणो यस्याद्य मुच्येत यं वा द्रोणः पराभवेद॥४६॥
इति तेषां प्रतिश्रुत्य मध्ये सर्वधनुष्मताम्।  आयाद्द्रोणं सहानीकः पाञ्चाल्यः परवीरहा॥४७॥
verses.english: Thus having sworn in the midst of all bowmen, that slayer of foes, viz., the Panchala prince rushed upon Drona, supported by his own division.
verses.bhavadeepa: इष्टापूर्तात्तथा क्षात्रादिति । इष्टं यागहोमादि । आपूर्तं क्षेत्रारामादि । क्षात्रं द्रुपदकुलोप्तन्नत्वात् । ब्राह्मण्यं याजोपयाजयोर्ब्राह्मणयोस्तपसा ब्राह्मणरूपादग्नेश्च जातत्वात् । एतत्सर्वं तस्य नश्यतु । यस्य शत्रुर्द्रोणो न मुच्येत मरणं न प्राप्नुयात्। यं वा मां वा द्रोणो यदि पराभवेदिति ॥४६॥

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चालास्त्वेकतो द्रोणमभ्यघ्नन्पाण्डवैः सह।  दुर्योधनश्च कर्णश्च शकुनिश्चापि सौबलः॥४८॥
verses.english: The Panchalas attacked Drona from one side whilst the Pandavas attacked him from the other. Then Duryodhana, Karna, Subala's son Sakuni.

verses.sanskrit: सोदर्योश्च यथा मुख्यास्तेऽरक्षन्द्रोणमाहवे।  रक्ष्यमाणं तथा द्रोणं सर्वैस्तैस्तु महारथैः॥४९॥
verses.english: And his other principal uterine brothers began to protect Drona in battle. Then the Panchalas, though striving hard, could not even look at Drona who was then being thus protected in battle by those high-souled warriors. Thereupon, O sire, Bhimasena became enraged with Dhistadyumna and then addressed that foremost of men in these harsh words.

verses.sanskrit: यतमानास्तु पञ्चाला न शेकुः प्रतिवीक्षितुम्।  तत्राक्रुध्यद्भीमसेनो धृष्टद्युम्नस्य मारिष॥५०॥

स एनं वाग्भिरुग्राभिस्ततक्ष पुरुषर्षभः।
              भीमसेन उवाच।
              द्रुपदस्य कुले जातः सर्वास्त्रेष्वस्त्रवित्तमः॥५१॥
कः क्षत्रियो मन्यमानः प्रेक्षेतारिमवस्थितम्।  पितृपुत्रवधं प्राप्य पुमान्कः परिपालयेत्॥५२॥
verses.english: Bhimasena said What man is there who, being regarded as a Kshatriya and who being born in the Dynasty of Drupada and who being foremost of all men possessing knowledge of weapons, would only thus passively look at his foe, stationed before him?

verses.sanskrit: विशेषतस्तु शपथं शपित्वा राजसंसदि।  एष वैश्वानर इव समिद्धः स्वेन तेजसा॥५३॥
verses.english: What person, having seen his father and son slain by his foes and having also sworn such a terrible oath in the assemblage of kings, would thus suffer his foe to stand before him?
verses.bhavadeepa: अवस्थितमरिमुक्तविधं शपथं शापित्वाऽपिः कः परिपालयेत्कस्तद्धननं न कुर्यादपि तु सर्वोऽपि तद्धननं कुर्यादेवेति सार्धः श्लोकः ॥५२॥

verses.sanskrit: शरचापेन्धनो द्रोणः क्षत्रं दहति तेजसा।  पुरा करोति निःशेषां पाण्डवानामनीकिनीम्॥५४॥
verses.english: Soon will he completely destroy the Pandava army; stand here passively as spectators of the feat I am going to perform; I myself assail Drona.

verses.sanskrit: स्थिताः पश्यत मे कर्म द्रोणमेव व्रजाम्यहम्।  इत्युक्त्वा प्राविशत्क्रुद्धो द्रोणानीकं वृकोदरः॥५५॥
शरैः पूर्णायतोत्सृष्टैर्द्रावयंस्तव वाहिनीम्।  धृष्टद्युम्नोऽपि पाञ्चाल्यः प्रविश्य महतीं चमूम्॥५६॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said Having thus spoken, Vrikodara, worked up with rage, penetrated into Drona's division; and he then routed your troops with arrows shot from his bow drawn to the fullest stretch.

verses.sanskrit: आससाद रणे द्रोणं तदासीत्तुमुलं महत्।  नैव नस्तादृशं युद्धं दृष्टपूर्वं न च श्रुतम्॥५७॥
verses.english: We never saw nor heard of such a battle before as, O king, was fought during that hour of sun-rise.

verses.sanskrit: यथा सूर्योदये राजन्समुत्पिञ्जोऽभवन्महान्।  संसक्तान्येव चादृश्यन् रथवृन्दानि मारिषः॥५८॥
हतानि च विकीर्णानि शरीराणि शरीरिणाम्।  केचिदन्यत्र गच्छन्तः पथि चान्यैरुपद्रुताः॥५९॥
verses.english: () sire, the chariots were then entangled with one another; thousands of corpses of slain creatures were also seen lying on the field of battle.

verses.sanskrit: विमुखाः पृष्ठतश्चान्ये ताड्यन्ते पार्श्वतः परे।  तथा संसक्तयुद्धं तदभवद्भृशदारुणम्।  अथ संध्यागतः सूर्यः क्षणेन समपद्यत॥६०॥
